request.deadline: 12 months; new grant period begins after closure of the existing contract
deliverables: Part-time maintainer for UTxO RPC over 12 months
Maintenance of the protobuf specification, including protocol compatibility, versioning, and documentation
Maintenance of official SDKs, including dependency updates, performance improvements, and bug fixing
Community support including issue triage, external contribution review, ecosystem-feedback enhancements, and public developer communication
AI-friendly documentation and integration resources for AI-driven development workflows
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe for maintaining Cardano's integration standard over a 12-month Year 2 period.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
UTxO RPC is described as an open interface specification using Protocol Buffers with SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
The proposer states that UTxO RPC has been adopted by Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node as a query interface.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, language SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations under the Apache 2.0 license.
The proposal states that UTxO RPC aligns with Intersect Strategic Pillar 2 focus area A.3 for developer experience and open-source maintenance incentives.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are described as being provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
The proposal says Intersect will manage withdrawn funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses and multi-party authorization thresholds.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA to continue 12 months of UTxO RPC maintenance by TxPipe, with deliverables around specification, SDK, community, and AI-workflow documentation work, administered through Intersect smart-contract treasury tooling.
